execution_preconditions: revalidate main clean and exact branch count/ref heads against audit JSON
revalidate production gen161 service_control PASS and two-worktree topology
create ignored private git bundle containing all 36 candidate refs and record SHA256 before deleting refs
revalidate each of 31 contained candidates is still ancestor of at least one retained local branch
revalidate each of 5 duplicate candidates still matches its retained representative by parent/tree/stable patch-id
delete local refs only; never push/delete remote refs
after deletion verify branch count=70, all retained heads unchanged, bundle verifies, production PASS

policy.phase17_extension_content_duplicate: A single-commit tip may be a deletion candidate when an explicitly retained representative has identical parent, tree, subject and stable patch-id. Exact deleted commit hashes must be recorded and a private Git bundle must be created before deletion.
policy.phase17_extension_local_containment: A main-unique branch pointer may be a deletion candidate if its HEAD is an ancestor of at least one explicitly retained local unique tip; this preserves its entire commit history locally.
policy.phase7_rule: A branch is main-deletion-safe only if ancestor-of-main or all divergent non-merge patches are git-cherry minus; any plus patch is not represented by main.
policy.remote_policy: Remote-tracking reachability is recorded but is never the sole preservation basis. No remote deletion is authorized.
